Plank Textures PBR 1.0 — A dog's life software
https://assetstore.unity.com/packages/2d/textures-materials/wood/plank-textures-pbr-72318
Planks4a albedo, normal, ambient occlusion and metallic maps are used on existing
beach timber, decks and piers. Object-aligned projection follows rotated meshes
without changing physical colliders. Existing authored seams are retained.

Acquired 2026-11-09. Standard Unity Asset Store EULA:
https://unity.com/legal/as-terms
Original asset hashes and source paths are recorded in the imported package's
source.json. Source asset bytes are retained; Unity import settings and generated
rendering assets are adapted for Built-in rendering.
